summary: In "Rivian Reports Quarterly Production and Delivery Numbers | RIVN Stock Analysis," published 8 Oct 2026, Parkevtate Vosianc CFA reacts to Rivian's Q3 production of 19,700 and deliveries of 19,200 — in line — plus full-year guidance of 65–70k units. The call: RIVN — HOLD. His DCF fair value of $13 is roughly his margin of safety, and the stock trades at a forward P/S of 1.7. He is warming from a years-long AVOID ("not overvalued anymore... fairly priced") but explicitly NOT upgrading yet: Rivian still needs ~200k units to be self-sustaining, is using only ~1/3 of capacity, and faces lower ASPs from the R2 mix. No flip vs logged calls (no prior RIVN call recorded). The digest excerpt also bundles same-day summaries of two other videos: Parkevtate's PEP BUY @ ~$125 reiterated from "1 Undervalued Dividend Stock You Can Buy and Hold Forever" (DCF FV $178, ~40% upside, cheapest fwd P/E 14x in years; prior BUY 2026-09-29 @ $128, no flip) and Mark Roussin's "3 Stocks with MASSIVE Upside" conditional-buy put-selling plays — CRDO CONDITIONAL_BUY via the Dec 18 $150 put (~$500 premium, effective basis ~$145; stock ~$220), GOOGL CONDITIONAL_BUY via the Dec 18 $300 put (~$400 premium; stock ~$350), and AMD CONDITIONAL_BUY via the Dec 18 $450 put (~$440 premium; stock ~$633 at ATHs, $1,000 call in 12–18 months).
